summary: Phase 149O.20C -- HATP Class-B Deployment Contract Independent Verification: INDEPENDENT-VERIFICATION ONLY, directly chartered by 149O.20B's own recommended-next-phase. Read docs/contracts/HATP_CLASS_B_DEPLOYMENT_CONTRACT.md (HBDC-001 v1.0, all 30 sections), docs/PHASE_149O_20A_HATP_DEPLOYMENT_READINESS_ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/PHASE_149O_20B_HATP_CLASS_B_DEPLOYMENT_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md, and cross-checked HMIC-REQ-063/064's exact quoted text against docs/contracts/HATP_MANDATORY_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION_CERTIFICATION_CONTRACT.md directly, not from 149O.20B's own summary or test file as oracle. Independently mechanically re-extracted HBDC-001's requirement inventory (55 unique, gapless HBDC-REQ-001..055 IDs), invariant inventory (8, CBD-1..CBD-8), and attack-matrix inventory (21 unique rows) directly from live contract text via fresh regex extraction, confirming every claimed count and confirming every traceability-table ID is normatively defined in the document body. Independently reconstructed 149O.20A's architecture decisions (two-OS-principal topology inherited from 149O.1B.1 with no third principal; Protected Root fixed-path resolution with no override/auto-create path; Model A -- editable install from the canonical repository working tree -- as the sole HMIC-REQ-064-certifiable topology; HMIC-REQ-063's conditional OPTION C disposition; DRA-REQ-001..011; the 15-entry deployment attack matrix; DRA-S1..S9, all confirmed NOT TRIGGERED) and confirmed HBDC-001 strengthens, and does not weaken, any DRA-REQ decision. Cross-checked HBDC-001's every major normative claim directly against live production source (src/pcae/core/hatp_bootstrap.py, repository_identity.py, hatp_mandatory_certification.py, hatp_mandatory_cutover.py): confirmed _default_production_trust_root() has no environment/CLI override path and no auto-creation call; confirmed _reject_symlink fails closed and is independently re-implemented in both hatp_bootstrap.py and hatp_mandatory_cutover.py; confirmed inspect_bootstrap_environment's agent/admin-shared-principal detection is a live os.getuid() check; confirmed no application-level admin mechanism (--admin flag, PCAE_ADMIN env var, is_admin function) exists anywhere in src/pcae/core or src/pcae/commands; confirmed the entire Model-A Python execution-environment lock (HBDC-REQ-025..039: PYTHONPATH, user-site, .pth, sitecustomize/usercustomize, meta_path import hooks) has zero corresponding production implementation yet -- an expected, disclosed gap consistent with HBDC-001 being contract-freeze-only, not a contract-text defect; confirmed derive_implementation_commit's _run_git() resolves a bare 'git' argument via PATH, the exact attack surface HBDC-REQ-038 names, with the contract's correctly-scoped deployment-level (not code-level) mitigation; confirmed resolve_canonical_deployment_root's strict-resolve canonicalization and deployment_binding_matches's dual-field check substantiate the worktree/clone/host-migration/backup-restore identity rules. Independently, empirically (not merely textually) confirmed the load-bearing self-binding question: direct inspection of hatp_mandatory_certification.py's _CONTRACT_IDENTITY_FILES (feeding contract_versions, HMIC-REQ-067) and _FROZEN_AUTHORITY_BEARING_FILES (the 24-file implementation_scope_digest set, HMIC-REQ-050) confirms HBDC-001's contract document is absent from both -- independently re-deriving, not merely accepting 149O.20B's own selection, that Option A is correct: HBDC-001 must join HMIC-001's bound-contract identity before real deployment trust may rely on it; this document also resolves a terminology ambiguity in the governing prompt between the repository's 8-contract total corpus and HMIC-001's own 4-entry contract_versions field. Independently reattacked all 21 frozen attack scenarios (setup/authority-target/defense/expected-outcome/verdict for each, not table-row-existence checking) and modeled 9 additional adversarial attacks beyond the frozen 21, none surfacing a Blocking finding. Answered all four load-bearing verification questions favorably: (1) the ordinary agent cannot acquire effective write/replacement authority over protected HATP/HMIC state; (2) the contract's environment-redirection defense is sound in text though not yet implementation-backed on any real host, honestly disclosed as such; (3) the Model-A/HMIC-REQ-063 OPTION-C treatment closes the intended threat model without overclaiming runtime provenance; (4) HBDC's deployment semantics can currently be changed after certification because HBDC-001 is not yet protected-bound -- confirmed to be the intentionally sequenced, disclosed, fail-closed prerequisite state, not a currently-exploitable gap, because real Class-B provisioning/certification remain independently blocked regardless. Zero Blocking findings. Three Non-Blocking findings recorded: (1) effective ACL/group-membership, full-ancestor-chain, and hard-link-alias detection required by HBDC-REQ-015/016/017/019 have no corresponding production implementation yet -- current inspect_bootstrap_environment/_assess_hatp_mandatory_activation_readiness_at_root checks are mode-bits-only (S_IWGRP/S_IWOTH, 0o022) and cover only the immediate parent, not the full ancestor chain; (2) the entire Model-A environment lock (HBDC-REQ-025..039) has zero production implementation; (3) _run_git()'s bare 'git' PATH resolution is worth a future code-level hardening consideration, not required by HBDC-001 v1.0 as written. Two Observations recorded (venv/editable-install ancestor-chain and symlink coverage stated explicitly only for Protected Root, not verbatim-restated for Section 13 paths -- transitively covered, not a bypass; and the governing prompt's 8-vs-9-contract terminology ambiguity, now resolved in the verification document). Wrote docs/PHASE_149O_20C_HATP_CLASS_B_DEPLOYMENT_CONTRACT_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md and tests/test_phase_149o_20c_hatp_class_b_deployment_contract_independent_verification.py (46 tests, all passed), independently re-deriving every inventory and cross-check from live text/source rather than importing 149O.20B's test constants as an oracle. Zero src/pcae/** and zero scripts/** files changed; HBDC-001 and all eight pre-existing bound contracts confirmed byte-unchanged at exit via direct git-status inspection -- this phase adds no new docs/contracts file (unlike 149O.20B), only the new phase-verification document. Regression (tests/test_phase_149o_20a_hatp_deployment_readiness_architecture.py plus tests/test_phase_149o_20b_hatp_class_b_deployment_contract_freeze.py): 45 passed, 0 failed. Broad sweep (pytest -k '149o_20 or hbdc or hmic or hatp_mandatory', excluding one pre-existing fido2-import collection error): 12 failed, 1224 passed, 2 skipped -- all 12 independently confirmed identical to a git-stash pre-phase baseline (pre-existing, unrelated to this phase, the same fixed-commit-anchor/environment-quirk repin-debt class documented since 149O.19.5E.2/E.3). Fast Green (python -m pytest -m fast_green, excluding one pre-existing fido2-import collection error): 26 failed, 6342 passed, 2 skipped -- all 26 independently confirmed identical to a git-stash pre-phase baseline via direct re-run with this phase's own new files stashed out, none newly introduced by this phase. Report trust (pcae phase-report trust): COMPLETE, all trust fields present. Report consistency (pcae phase-report consistency): consistent. Verdict: HBDC-001 v1.0 -- INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- HATP CLASS-B DEPLOYMENT CONTRACT CONFORMS. CLASS-B: CONTRACT VERIFIED -- NOT PROVISIONED. HBDC TRUST/BINDING DISPOSITION: INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED -- HBDC-001 MUST ENTER HMIC-001's PROTECTED BOUND-CONTRACT IDENTITY BEFORE REAL DEPLOYMENT TRUST MAY RELY ON HBDC-001. HMIC-REQ-063: OPTION C VERIFIED. No protected root, certification, active binding, revocation, Cutover Record, or activation marker exists anywhere on this host as a result of this phase. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. This phase does not recommend Class-B provisioning next. Recommended next phase: 149O.20D -- HMIC v1.2 HBDC Bound-Contract Identity Evolution (contract evolution only).
